context:
Goal: every lost PR the sweep finds reaches a session that fixes it.
Problem (goal): the sweep lists five row kinds; each needs one named owner or rows sit again.
Based on (read): step lost-work-sweep note, row kinds (a) to (e).
Departs from: main — adds owners: (a) done, in no batch over 6 h: runner 10; (b) record open, lane not told: the lane, or the coordinator if archived; (c) no review record, lane idle over 12 h: coordinator; (d) lane archived, PR open: coordinator; (e) doing step, lane gone: triage.

options.gain: Each row goes to the session that can act on it.
options.how: Runner 10 owns (a); the lane, or the coordinator if archived, owns (b); the coordinator owns (c) and (d); triage owns (e).
options.label: Split by row kind (coordinator's pick)

options.how: Every row goes to the coordinator, which routes it.
options.label: The coordinator owns every row
options.lose: The coordinator becomes the bottleneck for all lost work.

ref: coordinator 10:50 CST Nov 13; sent to triage 10:56 CST
reply: Closed 11:05 CST Nov 13 by triage: you accepted a at 11:03 CST. The row owners are with the lost-work-sweep lane. Undo: reopen this item.
short: Lost-work sweep: who fixes each row
title: Who fixes each kind of row the lost-work sweep finds?
why: The coordinator took this pick; it stands unless you choose b.
